title: Command Palette Dock is currently an empty bar on the top of my screen
author: Chochozuby
summary: Await the reporter's existing Edit Dock test; investigate missing pinned commands if configured items still do not appear.

next_action.label: Wait for the existing Edit Dock result
next_action.reason: A November 15 question already asks whether right-clicking the Dock and choosing Edit Dock helps; no answer is visible.

judgment.rationale: The only visible follow-up asks whether editing the Dock helps and remains unanswered. An empty bar does not establish that configured items fail to render.
evidence: The report describes an empty Dock bar on PowerToys 0.102.3101 and includes a screenshot and diagnostic archive.
On November 15 a contributor asked whether right-clicking the Dock and choosing Edit Dock helped; the reporter has not answered.
The supplied Command Palette log records unavailable pinned Bookmarks commands and skipped duplicate pinned commands. These warnings do not prove why the displayed bar was empty.

CommandProviderWrapper skips duplicate pinned commands and reports commands unavailable from a provider: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/6b3db15615e3e549b89790e0bd83c82d262c22e0/src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/CommandProviderWrapper.cs
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the existing Edit Dock answer. If configured items remain missing, compare available and unavailable providers in a disposable profile.

fix_assessment.rationale: A conditional Dock command-resolution or rendering fix may be needed if configured available items remain missing after the existing control.

proposed_fixes.title: Recover or clearly identify unavailable pinned Dock commands
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The log shows some unresolved and duplicate pinned commands, but it does not establish the cause of the empty bar.
plan: Confirm whether the reporter can add and display an available command through Edit Dock.
Reproduce provider resolution and duplicate handling with disposable configured commands and an unavailable provider.
If a resolution or rendering defect hides otherwise available commands, correct that path while preserving duplicate suppression.
verification: Available configured commands appear after reopening the Dock and unavailable commands do not hide unrelated available commands.

confidence.rationale: The existing control is unanswered and the warning messages do not prove a rendering defect.

issue_context.summary: Activating Command Palette Dock reportedly shows an empty bar on Windows 11.
known_information: The original report uses PowerToys 0.102.3101 and includes a screenshot and diagnostic archive.
The existing November 15 question asks whether right-clicking the Dock and choosing Edit Dock helps; no reply is visible.
The log reports unavailable pinned Bookmarks commands and skipped duplicate pinned commands.
inferences: Unresolved pinned commands could contribute to missing Dock content, but the available log does not establish that they caused the empty bar.
issue_context.analysis: Wait for the requested customization control rather than asking it again. A maintainer can separately examine command resolution using a disposable configuration.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and discussion, inspected the screenshot and relevant Command Palette log events, and checked CommandProviderWrapper on pinned upstream main.

information_gaps.information: Whether adding an available item through Edit Dock populates the bar
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguish an empty or unavailable configuration from a failure to display an available configured command.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply to the existing November 15 Edit Dock question with the result.

actions.label: Compare available and unavailable pinned Dock commands

prerequisites: Disposable Windows 11 profile with Command Palette Dock enabled and an available command provider.
steps: Right-click the Dock, choose Edit Dock, add an available command, and confirm whether it appears.
Restart Command Palette and check the same command again.
In a disposable configuration, make a different pinned provider unavailable and check whether the available command remains visible.
reproduce.expected_result: Available configured commands remain visible; an unavailable command does not hide unrelated available commands.
